scripts.check: vp check && pnpm knip && pnpm py:check
scripts.fix: vp check --fix && uv run --locked ruff check --fix . && uv run --locked ruff format .
scripts.test: vp run -r test && uv run --locked pytest
scripts.py:check: uv run --locked ruff check . && uv run --locked ruff format --check . && uv run --locked ty check --error-on-warning && uv run --locked basedpyright --warnings && uv run --locked pyrefly check --min-severity warn
scripts.bench: vp run -r --concurrency-limit 1 bench && uv run --locked python packages/python/bench/availability.py
scripts.ready: pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm test:packages
